steps.zh: 装 Transformers 的 serving extra

steps.en: Start a local OpenAI-compatible server on the 1.3B model
steps.zh: 用 1.3B 模型起一个本地 OpenAI 兼容服务

steps.en: Loads the open weights locally — every image stays on your device
steps.zh: 本地加载开放权重——每张图都留在自己设备上

steps.en: Post the image plus your question to the chat endpoint
steps.zh: 把图片和问题发到这个对话端点

steps.en: Answers on images, multi-images and video using compressed visual tokens
steps.zh: 用压缩视觉 token 回答单图、多图与视频问题

value.en: Pocket-sized image and video understanding running locally — no cloud round-trip, and the same weights reach phones via GGUF/Ollama and open mobile app code
value.zh: 口袋级的图像/视频理解全程本地跑——没有云端往返；同一份权重还能经 GGUF/Ollama 与开源移动适配代码进手机
